reason: The README describes a bridge that reads Pi Agent skills from a local configuration directory and exposes them as available skills in DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 将 Pi Agent 的本地技能定义注入 DeepSeek Harness，使其可作为可用技能使用。
summaries.en: Bridges local Pi Agent skill definitions into DeepSeek Harness as available skills.

capabilities: Reads Pi Agent skill definitions from the local ~/.config/pi/skills directory
Injects discovered skills into DeepSeek Harness as available skills
Supports configuration of skill enablement and maximum skill count
